title: Warm Middle Eastern Cheese Tartine
description: A flavorful and savory tartine featuring a warm cheese spread, topped with crispy elements and fresh herbs.
instructions: 2. In a medium bowl, mix together the softened Middle Eastern cheese and minced garlic.
3. Brush the sliced pita bread with olive oil and sprinkle with tagine spices.
4. Bake the pita bread in the oven for 5-7 minutes or until crispy.
5. In a small saucepan, warm the crumbly feta cheese over low heat.
6. Spread the warm cheese mixture onto the toasted pita bread.
7. Top with chopped cilantro and a sprinkle of tagine spices.
8. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
